manifest.name: doran-design
manifest.description: Doran's DSH skill pack for web design with shadcn/ui, Canvas UI and ThreeUI: three-layer architecture, performance budget and acceptance checklist.

bundle.text:
# dsh bundle patch: inserts this plugin into a profile's layer stack.
- insert:
    - id: doran-design
      name: doran-design

readme.text: A DSH skill pack for web and product UI design. It registers one agent skill and one short system-prompt section that makes the three-layer design rules apply to every web task.

- Skill `doran-design`: a full playbook covering
  - shadcn/ui as the structure layer
  - Canvas UI as the effect layer
  - ThreeUI / three.js as the 3D layer
  - the 80 / 15 / 5 visual-area split
  - component selection, performance budgets, fallbacks and an acceptance checklist
- System-prompt section `doran-design-rules`: a compact hard-rule set that always applies, including the one-GPU-effect-per-viewport rule, Radix UI Colors, 0.5px borders, the 12px minimum text size and the mobile/reduced-motion fallback requirement.
The plugin does not write `AGENTS.md`. The hard rules are contributed through `ctx.systemPrompt.section`, so installing the plugin is enough.

Install the prebuilt tarball from GitHub Releases:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/Doran1110/doran-design/releases/download/v0.1.1/doran-design-0.1.1.tgz
```

Then add the package to the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` list if your DSH version does not reconcile bundles automatically:

```json
{
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": ["doran-design"]

Restart the profile after installing.

Ask the agent for a landing page, dashboard, portfolio or any Canvas/WebGL/Three.js interface. The skill is model-invocable under the name `doran-design`; you can also invoke it explicitly with `/skill doran-design` where the client supports skill invocation.

- The plugin registers the same skill name as the local `doran-design` skill. Runtime skills rank 250, so the installed plugin takes precedence when both exist; keep only one to avoid duplicate catalogs.
- Runtime skills are registered at rank 250. If another provider exposes the same name, the nearest layer wins.
- The package ships no browser UI; `dsh.client` is intentionally absent.
- Requires DSH 0.1.0-rc.1 or newer.
